name: ARDENT VENGEANCE
text: This turning point a friendly Novitiate shooting, fighting or retaliating against an expended enemy has Punishing on its weapons, checked per target.

name: DEFENDERS OF THE FAITH
text: This turning point, when an enemy attacks a friendly Novitiate that contests an objective marker (or one of your mission markers), the damage of one normal success in that sequence is halved (rounded up, never below 2).

name: BLESSED REJUVENATION
text: This turning point, each time you spend Faith points on a Novitiate it can heal up to D3 lost wounds once that action is over, provided it is still standing; a free act (Auto-chastisers) spends nothing and heals nothing.

name: RIGHTEOUS ADVANCE
text: Not in the first turning point. Up to a third of your Novitiates in the killzone (at least one) each take a free Dash, one at a time. Each that Dashes must end closer to its closest enemy, its closest objective marker or the enemy drop zone.

name: GLORIOUS MARTYRDOM
text: A friendly Novitiate going down takes enemies with it: before it is removed, every enemy it can see within 2 inches suffers D3 damage, and you gain 1 Faith point for each.

name: BLAZING INFERNO
text: After a friendly Novitiate shooting with a Ministorum flamer dealt damage with a critical success, one such target gains your Blaze token. Whenever an operative with a Blaze token is activated it takes D3 damage, then its player may give it -1 APL until the end of that activation to remove the token.

name: BLINDING AURA
text: When an enemy selects a friendly Novitiate as the primary target of a Shoot: until that enemy's activation or counteraction ends, it cannot select that Novitiate while the Novitiate is more than 2 inches away. The enemy picks another target, or the Shoot ends if none is left.

name: GUIDED BY FAITH
text: As a friendly Novitiate declares a Shoot: until the action ends, its ranged weapon has Seek Light against targets within 6 inches.
